frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Cahier de texte, memo eleve et carnet personnel
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Corriger le sens metier du memo et developper les ecrans cahier, memo et carnet.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Math editor can start as text/limited image input while formula editor is selected.
Links to content catalog can use URL placeholders until content-catalog-service phase.

frontTests.item: Student can list, create and search memo chapters/items.
Student can open memo drawer during video session.
Teacher cannot write directly into student memo.
Teacher creates a cahier de texte page for linked student.

definitionOfDone.item: The current 403 student memo bug is resolved at UI/API contract level.
Memo is treated as an eleve-owned learning tool, not a teacher note.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
